item.title: KEY POINTS: Should foreign workers in Sweden join a union?
item.description: For many international workers in Sweden, joining a trade union might not be something that crosses your mind, especially if it's not common in your home country. Here are the benefits and key things to bear in mind when considering joining.

item.title: Today in Sweden: A roundup of the latest news on Monday
item.description: Migration minister proposes letting teenagers finish studies before deportation, 8-month-old baby to be deported alone to Iran, and other news from Sweden on Monday.

item.title: Outrage after Swedish Migration Agency orders baby to be deported
item.description: The Swedish Migration Agency has ordered an 8-month-old baby, who was born in Sweden, to be deported to Iran alone, generating outrage in the Swedish media over the weekend. The baby does not have a residence permit, but the rest of the family does.

item.title: Swedish government to look at allowing teen deportees to graduate
item.description: Swedish Migration Minister Johan Forssell has said that young people who lose the right to live in Sweden should be allowed to stay long enough to graduate from upper secondary school, in a further sign of government retreat on the issue.

item.title: Over 270 foreigners apply for 350,000 kronor grant to leave Sweden
item.description: Over 270 foreigners have applied to be paid to leave Sweden since the government's controversial 350,000 kronor 'return grant' came into force on New Year's Day, according to the first statistics on the take-up from the Migration Agency.

item.title: What it’s like being stuck in Sweden’s nightmare citizenship queue
item.description: A senior software engineer from Iran who has been living in Sweden for fifteen years applied for citizenship six years ago. Over a year after a court directed the Swedish Migration Agency to conclude his case, he's still waiting.

item.title: How to make The Local one of your preferred sources on Google
item.description: Do you like and trust The Local? Then please take a moment to add us as a preferred source on Google to ensure our articles appear in your searches.

item.title: Swedish word of the day: joråsåatte
item.description: Joråsåatte is not a word you’ll find in the dictionary.

item.title: Where to ski and snowboard during Sweden's 'sportlov' break
item.description: All across Sweden, skis and snowboards are getting waxed and edged in anticipation of the week-long break known as sportlov (winter sports holiday).

item.title: Swede suspected of helping over 100 men buy sex with his wife
item.description: A man in northern Sweden is suspected of helping more than 100 men buy sex with his wife, a prosecutor told AFP on Monday.
